look: a female kobold, a small dragon-like reptile-folk covered in deep brown-orange ochre scales, with a narrow cream band of belly plates down the middle of the chest, a horned dragon head with a broad blunt snout and a sturdy compact build
skin_words: deep brown-orange ochre scales, its small overlapping scale pattern
line_words: thin, crisp, dark brown contour line

horns.guide: A thick horn rises from each side of the back of the head, sweeps outward and backward and curves inward toward its tip.
horns.paint: the two horns as ridged warm brown-grey horn with a tan highlight

face_paint: the head as a top of the skull seen from above covered in small overlapping scales, with a row of raised keeled scales along its midline and, in the narrow strip along its bottom edge, a natural kobold face strongly foreshortened from above, a heavy scaled brow over small pale eyes and a broad blunt snout with two nostrils
torso_paint: the torso as a sturdy chest whose middle is a narrow band of cream-coloured banded belly plates, framed on both sides by flanks of small overlapping deep ochre scales, and a flat upper belly below
feet_tilt: At the very bottom the front halves of the two feet stand on the floor far below, toes pointing at the bottom of the picture, each a broad foot front with four toes that fan out and end in claws.
feet_paint: each foot front with four scaled toes ending in short dark claws
arms_paint: the shoulder band and the level arms covered all over in small overlapping deep ochre scales, each scale edged with a fine brown line
finish: soft matte painterly scaled skin with low contrast
note: Small overlapping scales cover the whole body, densely and evenly, in a deep brown-orange ochre midtone.
